subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should `message.send` strip or avoid all poll creation fields, or should it continue rejecting content-bearing poll fields such as `pollQuestion` and `pollOption` on send?
rationale: Current code intentionally fixes metadata-only schema padding but still rejects content-bearing poll fields, and the remaining fix changes the model-facing tool contract rather than only a local guard condition.

options.title: Action-scope poll schema
options.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `poll` or channel-specific poll surfaces so ordinary sends cannot inherit them from the shared schema.

options.title: Strip poll fields on send
options.body: Keep the unified schema but sanitize poll creation fields from `action="send"` before the guard and dispatch path.

options.title: Keep current strict guard
options.body: Accept the current shipped behavior and require fresh live evidence before changing how content-bearing poll params are treated on send.

recommendation.title: Action-scope poll schema
recommendation.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `poll` or channel-specific poll surfaces so ordinary sends cannot inherit them from the shared schema.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses outbound runtime, model-facing tool schema, and channel contract boundaries, and recent adjacent outbound refactor history makes this the best available routing candidate.
